What two people in the review list must share exactly before auto-merge takes them. Names are compared ignoring case, spacing and punctuation, emails ignoring case, and phone numbers by their digits; every value must be filled in on both. Two people whose birthdates are both filled in and differ are never merged. You always see the pairs before anything is merged.
